svg.aria-label: Four latent channels multiply a fixed 3 by 4 weight matrix and add a bias to give red, green and blue, with no VAE decoder.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: A fixed linear map turns 4 latent channels into 3 colours
colour input to the image encoder
No VAE decoder: each colour is a weighted sum of
the 4 channels at the same latent position
through the real map, not a picture
